You find a sign that, amazingly, hasn't been defaced or
destroyed by vandals.
According to the sign, there are several old department
stores that might or might not have been mostly looted and
raided by thieves and vandals.
One is in the NW corner just North of a restaurant.  Another
one is somewhat South and down the hall of the main
North-South hallway that joins levels, and around a corner
to the East off of that hallway.
Also another shop, or what's left of it, can be found in the
SE corner of this level.
A store that sells firearms and explosives and more is in
the NE corner of this level.
There are also three restaurants on this level.  One of them
is south of the store in the NW corner.  Another is somewhat
to the East of the center of this level and East of a store.
The third is mostly to the South and near a short turn to
the East off of the main North-South corridor.
Finally, there are also vending machines and seating in an
area to the West of the corridor on the South side.
This map is also apparently very old and is likely
out-of-date.  New places may have already sprung up in
various locations only to be ransacked and looted by vandals
and other riff-raff over the years.
